console102_compatibility.scope: exact control102 payload, separate maintenance sidecar, legacy web input

maintenance.timing_model: 8 ms per silent address; 0.2 ms per UART operation; 2 ms duplicate-reply collection; actual fixed sleeps. SSH, service process costs and calibration disk persistence excluded.

existing_service_switch.boundary:
V297: real child-process/lock handling and production transport/controller.

No real service, SSH, UART, servo, IMU or motion is used.

cases: ordinary focus and hide/show keep actual constructor state, drafts, DOM and existing position reader without requests or card writes
existing normal maintenance poll continues after focus without an additional loop or configuration refresh
hidden legitimate swap and IMU observations retain their actual reader eligibility while new hidden writes remain guarded
real failed position and IMU readers stay latched through ordinary focus and visibility changes without reconnects
actual pagehide keeps displayed state and drafts but invalidates freshness, and real pageshow restores one read loop without reentering or scanning
a pageshow on an already running page performs no maintenance refresh or view reset
actual APP registrations do not refresh config or recreate a healthy observer on ordinary focus visibility or initial pageshow
actual APP restores only its own unloaded cached-page observer once, and never retries a genuinely failed observer
a genuine cached-page restore initially hidden completes only its own paused observation when visible, without touching healthy or failed readers
actual scan click ACK progress and completion leave all four mode-card DOM attributes and copy unchanged
real accepted mode transitions update navigation while local center and swap locks remain enforced only at action dispatch
real switch failure unlocks all mode cards and displays one readable internal dialog without retrying or replacing the selected servo
uncalibrated motion click already in calibration displays one Chinese internal error after the real unchanged API reply instead of clearing it
a fallback that must start calibration explains the original motion rejection without claiming success or submitting a second operation
a pre-V294 backend target-only redirect still produces a readable rejection
already selected numbering explains why motion was not entered without a scan, native request or page reload
entering numbering as the prerequisite keeps one explicit entry and one rejection of the original motion click
valid new motion entry and opening an already running motion page remain successful without spurious calibration errors
V297 completed management with explicit IMU wait unlocks real menu dispatch into both bench modes without waiting for hardware readiness
V297 no ready feedback does not bypass an actually running service action or enable motion inputs
V297 missing IMU, one servo and several servos retain Chinese identifiers and exact original startup errors
lifecycle.style_review: A stable joint wrapper separates feedback/curve sizing from AI. Existing controlled tests cover navigation, request feedback and lifecycle; CSS is source-reviewed, with no browser pixels or computed geometry claimed.
lifecycle.boundary: Actual shipped constructor registrations, action/scan/maintenance/stream eligibility methods and APP lifecycle callbacks run with controlled DOM/API/timers/observer factory. Ordinary focus/visibility perform no refresh or reader restart; existing periodic reads remain. Actual pagehide cleanup and explicit hardware/input blur safety paths remain separate. No browser-engine BFCache, real WS/SSE transport, SSH/UART, 3D pixels or hardware acceptance.

model_views.limitation: DOM/CSS, actual model CPU transforms, telemetry rendering and marker placement verified. Browser and WebGL pixels were not tested in this run.

imu_layout.pixelTestLimit: Local Chromium launch was blocked by workspace UNIX socket restrictions.
